legs.variant: A — merchant path: sidebar Library link (App Router client-side nav) then browser Back
legs.observed: The Otto panel never unmounts on client-side navigation. While on /library the Messages region still held the complete conversation (885 chars incl. '✓ Done'); on arriving back at Home it was unchanged. Zero pageshow, zero visibilitychange, zero server action fired on arrival.
legs.copyNote: No waiting copy appeared, and none was needed: nothing ever unmounted or re-fetched, so there was no blank window on this path.
legs.specRelevance: Confirms the spec's branch ②: on an App Router client-side back (popstate) neither pageshow nor visibilitychange fires, so the R3-F27 immediate re-read does not run. On this build that costs nothing, because the panel keeps its state.

legs.variant: B — full-document-load excursion (/library via address bar) then browser Back
legs.bfcacheProof: a marker variable set on the Home JS context before leaving (window.__MARKER) was gone after Back => the document was re-created, not restored from bfcache. Therefore pageshow(persisted=true) cannot fire on this leg.

documentResponseHeaders.note: no-store is present on the Home document response, as the spec inferred but had not measured. Chrome documents no-store as a bfcache blocker; the marker test above confirms the blocking empirically on this build.

legs.status_reason: The copy half of this leg PASSES and is measured. The 'in-progress card catches up' half is NOT RUN: the job had already finished (37 s), so there was no working card to catch up. Measuring that half needs a longer job (video).

runs.retracted: This run sampled only innerText and recorded the Messages region as empty for 30 s. That reading is RETRACTED — see harnessArtifact below; the run did not sample the DOM, so it is not evidence that content was missing.

legs.status_reason: Copy half PASSES and is measured (visible from ~0.5 s until content lands at ~1.15 s). The 'in-progress card catches up' half is NOT RUN — the job was already terminal.

harnessArtifact.finding: While the Browser pane is hidden, Chrome skips layout for the Otto message list, so element.innerText returns '' for a region whose DOM is fully populated. In run 3, at 1148 ms the Messages region had 4 [data-message-id] nodes, innerHTML 17360 chars and textContent 1162 chars, while innerText read 0 and only became 624 at 1646 ms. In the Back-variant-B run innerText stayed 0 for the full 20 s while the DOM held the complete conversation the whole time.
harnessArtifact.consequence: Any measurement of 'the panel is blank' taken through innerText, get_page_text or read_page on a hidden pane over-reports blankness by seconds to tens of seconds.
harnessArtifact.relevanceToSpec: This independently reproduces the confound the R3-F27 row already registered (workflow-groups2-4-result.json) and makes it the leading explanation for the original, never-reproduced 40–60 s figure.
harnessArtifact.mitigation: DOM-level counters ([data-message-id].length, innerHTML.length, textContent.length) are layout-independent and were used for every number reported above.

giveUpCopyRule.reason: The image job finished in 37 s. The fast gear is 2.5 s × 48 ≈ 120 s, so the poll never left fast gear and the give-up copy ('This is taking longer than usual. Your credits for this are on hold…') and the terminal copy ('This looks stuck. Cancel it on the card to get your credits back…') were never eligible to appear. The per-batch re-arm gate (spec item g) therefore could not be exercised either. Both need a job longer than ~2 minutes — a video job.
